title: Analysis code for: auditing photovoltaic registries with remote sensing
description: Full analysis code for a national audit of rooftop photovoltaic registries by remote sensing: detection evaluation against 31,853 manual annotations, Bayesian correction of the detected capacity, comparison against two official registries with a specification battery, and the attribution of the flagged discrepancies to observable mechanisms. The replication dataset is deposited separately; see the repository README for what reproduces from it and what does not.
